title: Drawn pipe does not appear "instantly (same frame)" — view gates the topology rebuild on a sim-tick change
detail: Story 1.2 AC: "two pipes are created and appear instantly (same frame)". EndDraw's BuildSnapshot leaves Snapshot.Tick unchanged, so NativeTick's equal-tick path skips the rebuild; the pipe renders only after the next 20 Hz step (≤50 ms, up to 3 frames later). The comment claiming "THIS frame" is false.
recommended_fix: In NativeTick, rebuild the static world whenever the topology signature (node/pipe counts) differs from the last-rendered snapshot, independent of the tick-change gate; or have EndDraw bump a topology-revision counter the view polls.

title: Rejection reasons (self_loop/terminal_pair/span) are stored but never surfaced — dead code, no player feedback
detail: Story 1.2 AC: "a self-loop drag is rejected with `self_loop` [E3]; a terminal↔terminal drag is rejected [E26]; a span-exceeding drag is rejected". The bus computes the reason, the GameMode stores it "for the status line", but nothing reads it — rejections are invisible to the player.
recommended_fix: Render LastEditError in UPPRunView's status line (e.g. a transient "rejected: self_loop" chip) whenever bHasLastEditError is set, or expose it via UPROPERTY for the UI/MCP surface.

title: Camera fit is computed once with a 1280×720 fallback and never re-fit — comment claims "NativeTick re-fits" but it doesn't
detail: By the code's own premise (zero geometry at construction), the world is laid out at the 1280×720 fallback fit permanently; FPPCommandBus::ScreenToGrid instead uses the real PC->GetViewportSize(), so in any non-1280×720 viewport input mapping and rendered node positions diverge (E4 snap misses).
recommended_fix: Recompute FitScale/FitOffset in NativeTick when GetCachedGeometry().GetLocalSize() differs from the size the current fit was computed from, so the render mapping always matches the command bus's viewport-size mapping.

title: PPRunGameMode::StartRun comments misdescribe the code: demand is every 10 ticks (not 20) and fixture positions are hardcoded literals, not "PP_Scenario.h constants"
detail: Two comment inaccuracies: the loop spawns every 10 ticks, not 20; and the positions are duplicated literals, not PP_Scenario.h constants — if the golden scenario's positions ever change, PIE silently drifts from the golden fixture while the comment claims alignment.
recommended_fix: Fix the comments, and ideally add SCENARIO_*_X/Y position constants to PP_Scenario.h (or a shared fixture-spawn helper) so PIE and the golden scenario cannot drift.

title: U-E2 cleanliness assertion is scoped to Config/ only while its comment claims whole-tracked-tree hygiene
evidence:
scripts/local-ci.sh:147-153:
  # U-E2 hygiene: the full suite (editor boots + probes) must not dirty the
  # tracked tree. Snapshot BEFORE the gates; assert identical AFTER — a new
  # Config/ edit or untracked file created by a gate run fails loud.
  dirty_before="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
  run_gates "${#GATES[@]}"
  gate_rc=$?
  dirty_after="$(git status --porcelain -- Config/ 2>/dev/null)"
detail: Story 0.1 carried hygiene asks for "a git status --porcelain cleanliness assertion in CI"; the implemented assertion snapshots only Config/. The comment's "tracked tree" claim overreaches — editor-written dirt outside Config/ (gates 4-6) passes silently.
recommended_fix: Either widen the before/after snapshot to the full tree (git status --porcelain, ignoring Saved/ via .gitignore) or narrow the comment to state the assertion is Config/-scoped by design.
